subject: Post-call: Redwood inference discovery + procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Redwood inference discovery + procurement next steps

Hi Emily — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: model inference for transaction categorization + risk signals (batch and real-time)
- Target latencies: 50–150ms p95 for real-time routes; batch daily scoring for historical data
- Data residency: US-only; no PII persisted in hosted logs
- Success criteria: parity with current latency requirements and 30% reduction in per-token inference cost

Stakeholders we identified (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: VP of Ops (you) + CFO (finance sign-off)
- Security contact: InfoSec (to run security questionnaire)
- Procurement / AP: handles vendor onboarding, PO and invoicing

Immediate asks / next steps: 
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and the primary procurement contact + remit address for PO/invoice?
2) I’m attaching: SOC2 report (summary), vendor onboarding form, and our W9. Can you confirm if that’s sufficient for initial vendor review?
3) Tentative timeline: once procurement confirms required docs, typical onboarding + SSO/secrets exchange takes ~2–4 weeks; procurement/PO timing varies.

Attachments: SOC2_report_v3.pdf (summary), vendor_onboarding_form.docx, W9_redwood.pdf

I’ll follow up with a one-pager on pricing and an estimated monthly spend range based on the traffic you described. Happy to set a call with finance/procurement if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

---
(Attachment stubs included above)

From: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@acme-fintech.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-fintech.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood inference discovery + procurement next steps

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few items from procurement and InfoSec: 

Procurement checklist items we typically need:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we’ll start that)
- Signed W9 and remit instructions (finance)
- Standard PO terms: Net30 preferred; please confirm if Redwood accepts Net30
- Commercial estimate / SOW so finance can provision budget

Security / legal asks:
- InfoSec will run a security assessment; primary reviewer is J. Singh (j.singh@acme-sec.com). They will request SOC2 Type II, DPA, and clarification on data flow (what is sent to Redwood, logs retention).

Operational timeline: procurement will kick off onboarding once we have SOC2, W9, and your onboarding form. Assuming no red flags, procurement aims to issue PO within ~2 weeks of receiving those docs, but CFO sign-off can extend to 3–4 weeks.

I’m attaching our procurement checklist to speed alignment. Can you also provide a ballpark ARR or monthly spend estimate for the configuration we discussed (realtime + daily batch)?

Emily
VP of Operations, Acme Fintech
emily.rogers@acme-fintech.com

(Attachment: procurement_checklist_acme.xlsx)
